A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Appropriate personal protective 
equipment must be used as safety shoes, Helmet, breathing mask, and safety glasses.
Circuit breaker must be fully isolated.

Earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker to ensure it is 
 properly grounded.
Complete set of substation maintenance hand tools including screwdriver set, torque wench.

Emergency 
light, 220 Vac supply.

Portable 
pressure gauge standard, and Endscope.
Check visually all components of the circuit breaker.
Check the oil levels in tanks.

Check the tightness of hydraulic circuits.
 (pipes and components)

Check the wiring of the
 hydraulic panel ref. electrical diagram.

Check the condition of the
 electrical connections.
Check the position of mechanical optical indicators.

Measure the time necessary for the pump motor
 of the hydraulic operating mechanism to reach level VE after a cycle OCO performed starting Kiosk >3min.

Measure the SF6 filling pressure of
 the compartments. (6 bar)

Measure stages of SF6
 pressure of the compartments. (alarm 5.2bar, auto trip 5 bar)

Test the operation of the internal
 arc detector using endscope.

Record the response times on opening:
 For line circuit breakers starting from the moment when the voltage is applied to the tripping coil until the opening of contacts. The time should be inferior to 27 ms.

Record the synchronism on opening: It should be inferior or equal to 5 ms.
 (the delay time between phases not greater than 5 ms).

Record the response times on closing: 
 For line, circuit breakers starting from the moment when the voltage is applied to the closing coil until the closing of the contacts. The time should be including between 54 to 70 ms.

Record the synchronism on closing: It should be inferior or
 equal to 5 ms. (the delay time between phases not greater than 5 ms).

Introduction
